title: Keep: non-blocking slot cap returns retryable 503
description:
git-vouch-trqp:37-41, :213-222. When every slot is busy, the bridge refuses immediately with a retryable unavailable instead of queueing. This is a constraint, not a mechanism: there is no queue depth, fairness or wait timeout to tune, and verify-trust already fails closed on unavailable, so CI retries. A blocking acquire() would instead pile threads up behind slow checks; with a thread per connection (line 10) that is the exhaustion the cap exists to prevent.

Do NOT "improve" this to a blocking or timed acquire. If capacity is short, make each check cheaper (vouch-s9w2.1).
